documented_probe: C-787a6a13 (maintain gradient flow through the full composed model): second independent covering task. A torch nn.Module composes four stages but two intermediates are detached / computed under no_grad, so a backward pass populates no gradient on the context and gate parameters and training stalls. The agent must restore graph connectivity without changing the public API, prove the fix with a per-parameter gradient audit, retrain to loss/accuracy targets, and persist auditable artifacts.
notes: Distinct from basalt-ridge (pure-numpy autograd framework with a broken backward op): here the framework is torch and the failure is in the FORWARD graph topology (detach + no_grad), diagnosed via a per-parameter gradient audit on a fixed probe batch. The verifier imports the deliverable pipeline, builds the model on every hidden fixture, asserts finite non-zero gradients on every named parameter after one backward, and re-executes the trainer end-to-end checking loss <= 0.15 and holdout accuracy >= 0.88 with a consistent report. Medium: two-point diagnosis, moderate training loop, hidden-fixture generalization.
